basics.name: Abel Casas García
basics.label: Backend Engineer | Software Architect | AI & Automation Specialist
basics.summary: Software Engineer specialized in backend development, robust architectural design, and the integration of Artificial Intelligence into enterprise systems. With a proven track record in high-availability and business-critical platforms, I focus on building clean, scalable, and decoupled systems through strict application of SOLID principles and Hexagonal Architecture. In parallel, I architect and build solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents, streamlining the software development lifecycle and elevating operational efficiency via advanced automations.

Integrated LLMs and autonomous AI agents strategically for code generation, smart debugging, workflow analysis, and automated technical documentation.
Championed modern methodologies like SDD (Software/Specification Driven Development) to increase predictability and significantly accelerate Time-to-Market.
